Adversus Catharos et Valdenses (Moneta of Cremona (Tommaso Agostino Ricchini, ed.), 1743)
======================================================================
Moneta of Cremona's Adversus Catharos et Valdenses Libri Quinque (c. 1241) in Ricchini's 1743 Rome edition — the great Dominican scholastic summa against the Cathars and Waldensians, five books of systematic refutation. Latin. The high-medieval theological counter-offensive in full. Public domain. Sourced from Internet Archive: scan of the 1743 edition (https://archive.org/details/venerabilispatri00mone).
